title: HSD11B1 suppresses ferroptosis in endometrial stromal cells through the JUND/IL-10 axis to promote endometriosis progression.
authors: Yang, Yuan; Huang, Yi; Wang, Yidan; Li, Ruiyun; Li, Hongrui
one_liner_zh: 该文研究HSD11B1通过JUND/IL-10轴抑制子宫内膜间质细胞铁死亡促进子宫内膜异位症，虽涉及转录因子JUND与IL-10启动子结合，但核心是疾病机制与铁死亡，无AI/物理模拟方法，且非TF-DNA互作建模研究。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Endometriosis (EMs) is a common gynecological disorder characterized by ectopic endometrial tissue growth, leading to chronic inflammation and pelvic pain. Despite its high prevalence, the molecular mechanisms underlying EMs remain poorly understood. This study aims to identify key biomarkers and elucidate the role of ferroptosis in EMs pathogenesis. METHODS: We integrated machine learning approaches with single-cell transcriptomic analysis to screen for ferroptosis-related genes in EMs. Candidate genes were prioritized based on differential expression and diagnostic performance. Functional validation was conducted using in vitro and in vivo models, including primary ectopic endometrial stromal cells (EESCs) and a mouse model of EMs. RESULTS: HSD11B1 was identified as a core ferroptosis-related gene with high diagnostic value. Mechanistically, elevated HSD11B1 expression upregulated the transcription factor JUND, which directly bound to the IL-10 promoter and enhanced its expression. This HSD11B1/JUND/IL-10 axis suppressed ferroptosis in EESCs, as evidenced by increased cell viability, reduced lipid peroxidation, decreased Fe(2)(+) and malondialdehyde levels, and preserved mitochondrial morphology. Knockdown of HSD11B1 or JUND reversed these effects, while IL-10 overexpression partially rescued the ferroptosis-resistant phenotype. Elevated expression of HSD11B1, JUND, and IL-10 was further confirmed in ectopic lesions from both EMs mouse models and patient samples. CONCLUSIONS: Our findings identify HSD11B1 as a key regulator of ferroptosis in endometriosis via the JUND/IL-10 signaling axis, suggesting that HSD11B1 may serve as a potential non-invasive biomarker and a candidate therapeutic target for EMs pending further clinical validation.
abstract_zh: 背景：子宫内膜异位症（EMs）是一种常见的妇科疾病，其特征是异位子宫内膜组织生长，导致慢性炎症和盆腔疼痛。尽管其患病率较高，但EMs的分子机制仍知之甚少。本研究旨在识别关键生物标志物，并阐明铁死亡（ferroptosis）在EMs发病机制中的作用。方法：我们整合了机器学习方法与单细胞转录组分析，以筛选EMs中与铁死亡相关的基因。基于差异表达和诊断性能对候选基因进行优先排序。使用体外和体内模型进行功能验证，包括原代异位子宫内膜基质细胞（EESCs）和EMs小鼠模型。结果：HSD11B1被鉴定为核心铁死亡相关基因，具有高诊断价值。机制上，HSD11B1表达升高上调了转录因子JUND，后者直接结合IL-10启动子并增强其表达。该HSD11B1/JUND/IL-10轴抑制了EESCs中的铁死亡，表现为细胞活力增加、脂质过氧化减少、Fe(2)(+)和丙二醛水平降低，以及线粒体形态保持。敲低HSD11B1或JUND逆转了这些效应，而IL-10过表达部分挽救了铁死亡抵抗表型。在EMs小鼠模型和患者样本的异位病灶中，进一步确认了HSD11B1、JUND和IL-10的升高表达。结论：我们的研究结果将HSD11B1鉴定为通过JUND/IL-10信号轴调控子宫内膜异位症中铁死亡的关键调节因子，提示HSD11B1可能作为EMs的潜在非侵入性生物标志物和候选治疗靶点，有待进一步临床验证。
